title: Friendship
definition: Friendship is a God-given relationship of love, loyalty, encouragement, truth, companionship, and mutual care.
summary: Biblical friendship helps people walk in wisdom, love, truth, and faithfulness.
christFocus: Jesus is the truest Friend who lays down His life for His people and teaches them to love one another.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Friendship is a meaningful gift from God. Biblical friendship includes loyalty, honesty, encouragement, correction, compassion, shared burdens, and joy.

Good friends help one another walk wisely. They speak truth in love, resist flattery, remain present in difficulty, and encourage faithfulness to God.

Jesus dignifies friendship by calling His disciples friends and laying down His life for them. Human friendship is strengthened when it reflects His love and truth.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many people are lonely or surrounded by shallow connections. Friendship matters because God often uses faithful friends to strengthen, correct, encourage, and protect His people.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Pursue friendships marked by truth and love. Be the kind of friend who encourages obedience, tells the truth gently, bears burdens, and points others to Christ.
